problem:
$$
f(x,z)=⟨x,\,\text{___},\,z⟩
$$

The vector-valued function $f(x,z)$ above parametrizes the parabolic cylinder defined in Cartesian coordinates as $y=12{x}^{2}.$ What is the second component of $f?$
worked_solution:
For any point $(x,y,z)$ on our surface, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,z) & =⟨x,y,z⟩ \\  & =⟨x,\,12{x}^{2},\,z⟩\end{aligned}
$$

where $x\in (-\infty ,\infty )$ and $z\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$

Therefore, the second component of $f$ is $12{x}^{2}.$
